title: Nice design, nice price.
text: Nice design, nice price.. ... it's a bread knife!

product_metadata.title: Maarten Serrated Bread Knife, Black Upgraded One Piece Design Sharp Sandwich Knife - Bread Cutter Knife for Slicing Homemade Bread, Bagels, Cake (8 Inch With Sheath)
features: 🥯Ultra-Sharp Serrated Blade: This 8-inch bread knife has an ultra-sharp serrated blade. After mechanical analysis and testing of various blades, a curved serrated blade was designed; this blade easily slices through the hardest bread. It provides you with a clean and smooth cut and perfect slices every time.

🍔Excellent Quality: This serrated knife is made of food-grade high-carbon stainless steel. The thickness is only 2.2 mm and 0.1 mm. It is resistant to dirt, rust and corrosion. It provides users with excellent strength and tool hardness, making our bread knife an excellent choice for breads of all kinds.

🥖One-Piece Design: This bread slicing knife adopts an ergonomic one-piece design, with a comfortable non-slip handle, and is carefully crafted to perfectly fit any grip. It can easily cut hard bread, and can be used for a long time without causing fatigue. This serrated bread knife is safer and more comfortable to use! It allows you to slice comfortably and easily.

🍕Multifunctional Cutting: This bread knife accurately cuts crusty bread, cakes, sandwiches, bagels, pastries, French baguettes and brioches. You can even chop up pineapple, watermelon and tomato slices with this special knife. In order to guarantee the customer experience, the black bread knife designed by Maarten is very easy to clean.

🥪Perfect Gift: If you are looking for a perfect gift, then this baguette bread knife is the best choice! It makes a great gift for home chefs, professional gourmet chefs, culinary students or as a Christmas, Father’s Day, or Mother's Day gift.
